evidence.text: Bifunctional protein FolD: methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NADP+) / methenyltetrahydrofolate cyclohydrolase

menu.label: methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
menu.description: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate + NADP+ = 5,10-methenyltetrahydrofolate + NADPH + H+.

menu.label: methenyltetrahydrofolate cyclohydrolase activity
menu.description: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,10-methenyltetrahydrofolate + H2O = 10-formyltetrahydrofolate + H+.

picks.why: The annotation names the NADP+-dependent dehydrogenase half of FolD outright.
The annotation also names the cyclohydrolase half, which this term covers.
Bifunctional FolD carries this activity; the EC and the wording both line up.
Second activity of the same bifunctional protein.
NADP+ is named, so the protein must bind NADP, though that is implied rather than stated as a function.

ballots.notes: NADP binding is inferred, not asserted.

critic.reason: Both catalytic terms are clearly supported. GO:0050661 is a binding term inferred from the cofactor named in the dehydrogenase activity, not an independently stated function.
